# FocusLearn

> FocusLearn is a free web app for learning from YouTube videos. You paste a YouTube link, watch it in a distraction-free player, then write a recap from memory. An AI checks your recap against the video's transcript and tells you what you got right, what you missed and what you got wrong.

FocusLearn is for people who want to remember what they watch, not just finish it: students, self-learners and anyone working through lectures, tutorials, talks or online courses on YouTube.

It is not a flashcard, quiz or spaced-repetition app. There are no generated questions or review schedules. The one exercise is free recall: explaining the video back in your own words.

## How it works

1. Watch: the video plays on its own, without YouTube's sidebar, comments or autoplay. Sponsor segments are skipped automatically (using SponsorBlock), and the video's chapters are shown when it has them.
2. Take notes: add notes while you watch. Each note is pinned to the timestamp where you wrote it, so you can jump back to that moment.
3. Recall: when the video ends, write what you learned from memory.
4. Compare: the recap is graded against the transcript. Feedback lists what you nailed, what you missed and what was not quite right, each linked to the moment in the video, plus a score out of 100.
5. Revisit: rewatch the same video later, add to your notes, update your recap and see whether your score improves.

Every session (video, notes, recap and feedback) is saved to a private personal library.

## Good to know

- Price: free to use right now.
- Account: sign in with Google or GitHub. No password.
- Captions: grading needs the video's transcript, so the video must have captions. Without them you can still watch and take notes.
- Best for: videos with a clear point, such as lectures, tutorials, talks and courses. Very long videos (over about an hour) may be too long to grade.
- Platform: runs in any modern browser; nothing to install.
- Browser extension (optional, Chrome and Edge): adds an "Open in FocusLearn" button to YouTube videos. Clicking it pauses YouTube and continues the same video at the same second in FocusLearn.
- Privacy: each library is private to its owner. Recaps and transcripts are sent to an AI provider only to grade them. FocusLearn does not sell data or show ads.
